In this repository (a Go project, github.com/usememos/memos, at /bench/repo), memos have a "visibility" field (likely an enum: PRIVATE, PROTECTED, PUBLIC — check `store.Memo.Visibility` or `storepb`/proto for `Visibility`). I need to find EVERY distinct server-side location/surface where memo visibility is checked/enforced to control who is allowed to view a memo. There are at least three separate enforcement sites across different server surfaces (e.g. the main gRPC/REST API service, the RSS feed generator, the file/attachment server, SSE streaming, etc.)

Search the whole repo for:
- "Visibility" checks combined with authorization logic (comparisons to `store.Visibility` constants like `PRIVATE`/`PUBLIC`/`PROTECTED`, or `memo.Visibility ==` / `!=` comparisons combined with a currentUser/creator check)
- Look in: server/router/api/v1/*.go (memo_service.go, memo listing/filtering), server/router/rss/*.go (RSS feed), server/router/fileserver/*.go (attachment serving — does it check the parent memo's visibility before serving an attachment?), server/router/api/v1/*sse*.go or notification code, and any ACL/interceptor code (server/router/api/v1/acl*.go or auth interceptor).

For each distinct enforcement site found, report: what surface it protects, the function name, and file:line, plus roughly what the check looks like (e.g. "if memo.Visibility == PRIVATE && memo.CreatorID != currentUserID: deny").

Be thorough - I need AT LEAST three distinct sites, ideally find all of them.

content.text:
I found the visibility enforcement logic across the codebase. Here is a complete inventory of every distinct server-side site that checks/enforces memo `Visibility` for read/access control, organized by surface.

## 1. Main gRPC/REST API — core memo read-access gate
**`checkMemoReadAccess`** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68`
The central helper used by `GetMemo` (calls at line 356, and again on the parent memo at line 367) and by `ListMemoComments` (`memo_service_comments.go:148`).
```go
if memo.RowStatus == store.Archived { ... only creator ... }
if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
    user, _ := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
    if user == nil { return Unauthenticated }
    if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
        return PermissionDenied
    }
}
```

**`ListMemos` filtering** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
Rather than a per-item check, it constrains the query itself: anonymous users get `VisibilityList = [Public]`; authenticated users viewing someone else's memos get a filter `creator_id == me || visibility in [PUBLIC, PROTECTED]` (or `VisibilityList = [Public, Protected]` when listing a specific other creator).

## 2. Reactions (gRPC/REST)
`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`
- `ListMemoReactions` (lines 29-41): `if memo.Visibility != store.Public { ... if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) { deny } }`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` (line 83): `if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) { deny }`

## 3. Comments (gRPC/REST)
`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`
- `CreateMemoComment` (line 41): `if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) { deny }`
- `ListMemoComments` (line 148) reuses `checkMemoReadAccess` above.

## 4. Attachments via the gRPC/REST API (two separate services)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-453` — generic attachment permission check: `if memo.Visibility == store.Public { allow }`, `if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) { deny }` (implicitly allows PROTECTED to any authenticated user).
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-224` (`ListMemoAttachments`) — same pattern.

## 5. Mentions/inbox notification fan-out
`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56-89`
`canUserAccessMentionContext` (line 56) and `shouldSkipMentionInbox` (line 74) gate whether a mentioned user gets an inbox notification: `if memo.Visibility == store.Private && target.ID != memo.CreatorID { deny }` (checked against both the memo and, if present, its `relatedMemo`).

## 6. User notifications / inbox rendering
`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302-316`
`canViewerAccessMemo(viewer, memo)` — used when rendering notification payloads so a viewer can't see snippet/content of a memo they lost access to:
```go
if viewer.Role == RoleAdmin { allow }
if memo.Visibility == Private { return viewer.ID == memo.CreatorID }
if memo.Visibility == Protected { return viewer != nil }
return true
```

## 7. SSE (Server-Sent Events) live streaming — distinct enforcement surface
`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-144`
`(*SSEClient).canReceive(event *SSEEvent)`:
```go
switch event.Visibility {
case store.Private:
    return c.userID == event.CreatorID || c.role == store.RoleAdmin
case store.Public, store.Protected, "":
    return true
default:
    return false // deny unknown visibility
}
```
Events are tagged with visibility/creator in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go:29-37` before broadcast, and delivery is filtered in `Broadcast` at `sse_hub.go:122-125`.

## 8. Attachment/file server (Echo HTTP, separate from the gRPC attachment endpoints) — distinct surface
`/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-704`
`(*FileServerService) checkAttachmentPermission`:
```go
if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() { allow }
// share_token fallback for PRIVATE/PROTECTED memos
if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin { deny }
```
This resolves the parent memo of the requested attachment and checks its visibility before streaming file bytes — a completely separate code path from `attachment_service.go`/`memo_attachment_service.go`.

## 9. RSS feed generator — distinct surface
`/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go` — `GetExploreRSS` (line 90) and `GetUserRSS` (line 141) both hard-code `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}` on the `store.FindMemo` query, so only PUBLIC memos are ever fetched/rendered into the feed (enforced at the query level, not post-hoc).

## 10. Sitemap generator — distinct surface
`/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go:149-151`
`getSitemapXML` also queries with `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}`, so only public memo URLs are listed in `/sitemap.xml`.

## 11. Email notification dispatcher — distinct surface
`/bench/repo/server/notification/email.go:306-320`
`canViewerAccessMemo(viewer, memo)` (a second, separately-defined function of the same name, package-local to `notification`):
```go
if viewer.Role == RoleAdmin { allow }
if memo.Visibility == Private { return viewer.ID == memo.CreatorID }
if memo.Visibility == Protected { return viewer != nil }
return true
```
Used to decide whether an email notification recipient is allowed to see the memo content/link before sending.

### Summary of distinct enforcement surfaces
1. Main gRPC/REST memo API (`checkMemoReadAccess` + `ListMemos` query filtering) — `memo_service.go`
2. Reactions API — `reaction_service.go`
3. Comments API — `memo_service_comments.go`
4. Attachment API (x2: `attachment_service.go`, `memo_attachment_service.go`)
5. Mention/inbox fan-out — `memo_mention_helpers.go`
6. Notification rendering (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — `user_service_notifications.go`
7. SSE live-streaming hub — `sse_hub.go` / `sse_event_helpers.go`
8. File/attachment server (Echo HTTP) — `fileserver/fileserver.go`
9. RSS feed generator — `rss/rss.go`
10. Sitemap generator — `frontend/frontend.go`
11. Email notification dispatcher (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — `notification/email.go`

That's well beyond the three required — 11 independently-implemented enforcement sites, several of which (SSE hub, file server, RSS, sitemap, email dispatcher) are fully separate code paths from the main gRPC memo service and would each need to be patched independently if the visibility model changed.
